examples.text: Mój pies kocha mnie niuchać, gdy wracam do domu.
examples.translation: My dog loves sniffing me when I get home.
examples.english: My dog loves sniffing me when I get home.

glosses: to poke about in order to find something, to snoop around

examples.text: Przestań niuchać w moim domu albo będziesz miał kłopoty!
examples.translation: Stop poking around in my house or you're going to be in trouble!
examples.english: Stop poking around in my house or you're going to be in trouble!

examples.text: Znam gościa, co ciągle niucha tabakę.
examples.translation: I know a guy who is always snorting snuff.
examples.english: I know a guy who is always snorting snuff.

glosses: inalare tabacco o sostanze stupefacenti (come la cocaina in polvere) inspirando energicamente con una narice mentre si mantiene chiusa l'altra con una leggera pressione del dito
definizione mancante; se vuoi, aggiungila tu
